title: Effort Peer Effects in Team Production: Evidence from Professional Football
eligible_reason: No binary staggered treatment. All regressions (Tables 2-7, A1, 2A) regress player or team outcomes on continuous peer-effort measures (plaavspeed, teamdist_ex_mean, dist_gap, team_dist/opp_dist) with player/section/game or contest-pair/round FE; Tables 4, 5 and 7 use IV (season-average peer distance instruments) via ivreghdfe; Table 6 is a first-difference-around-substitution design with IV. Peer-effects regression, not a DiD.
design_notes: Package replication_package_MS-BDE-21-00762: do/master_forrep.do runs data_prep, Tables_2_3_1A, Tables_4_5_7, subs_databuilder, Table_6, figures, Table_2A. Data dta/orig_DB_forrep.dta and dta/UCL_DB.dta with codebooks (xls). 106 regression commands, all reghdfe/ivreghdfe with continuous regressors and control sets (dhomegame rank_gap player_cumsections, pre-section controls, crowd controls). Flag cite_dcdh_2020 presumably refers to a citation in discussion only.
